representation.rationale: Round-1 residual_cnn (hidden=64, depth=4) scored 98.7% val accuracy. This candidate widens hidden to the 96 cap for residual_cnn, adds one more residual block (depth=5) for richer feature hierarchy, slightly lowers LR (8e-4 vs 1e-3) to stabilise the wider network, and reduces label smoothing to 0.05 since the model is already well-calibrated. Dropout is trimmed to 0.15 to let the extra width carry more signal. Weight decay nudged to 2e-4 for mild L2 regularisation without suppressing the low-variance channel features.
